_doc: PERMANENT Forge agent registry (user decision 2026-07-05). These names are FIXED across every project — never invent new/random agent names for work these roles cover. Extra agents are allowed ONLY with: permanent standardized name + clear role + default skill bundle + suitable model assignment + self-review duty + a place in the Boss→Head Chef→QA loop (add them HERE, template-first, then sync). Runtime note (honest): agents run as Claude Code subagents (Agent tool); 'claudeTier' is the runtime model. NVIDIA models are called AS TOOLS by agents via forge-bin/nvidia-provider.cjs per agent-model-map.json.
loop: User → Boss (mission) → Head Chef (exact work packages) → Skill Boss (skills attached) + model routing check → subagents (each self-reviews before done) → Test Boss (automated tests) → UI Boss (visual, when relevant) → SEO Boss (perf/site, when relevant) → Security Boss → Review Boss (final QA) → fail? structured failure report → Boss → Head Chef assigns fixes → re-test → Review Boss again → repeat until genuine pass or truthful blocker.

boss.name: Boss
boss.responsibilities: Owns the mission: split into tasks, assign, track, receive QA failure reports, decide fix strategy, reassign until pass; decides when premium fallback (Opus/Sonnet) replaces a cheaper model; final owner of quality.

head-chef.name: Head Chef
head-chef.responsibilities: Convert Boss instructions into exact step-by-step work packages; verify every subagent completed its goal; prevent random/duplicate work; ensure each task has the correct agent + skill bundle + model; send unclear/failed work back to Boss.

review-boss.name: Review Boss
review-boss.responsibilities: End-of-project review vs the user goal: design, code quality, logic, security, tests, UX, edge cases, missing features; structured failure report to Boss; never approve until genuinely good; strong review model required.

test-boss.name: Test Boss
test-boss.responsibilities: Websites/apps: Playwright — buttons, forms, links, menus, modals, filters, flows, mobile nav, keyboard/loading/error states, many interaction checks (not one happy path). Other project types: the correct automated test strategy. Produce real test proof + failures.

ui-boss.name: UI Boss
ui-boss.responsibilities: Premium, professional, unique, responsive, modern interfaces; purposeful animation; mobile/tablet/desktop; screenshot loops for visual verification; fix oversized text, spacing, contrast, weak layout.

seo-boss.name: SEO Boss
seo-boss.responsibilities: Websites: metadata, structure, headings, performance, accessibility, image optimization, CWV-style issues, schema, indexability. Non-web: performance, discoverability, documentation clarity, runtime efficiency.

security-boss.name: Security Boss
security-boss.responsibilities: Keys/env vars/auth/webhooks/input validation/injection/unsafe logs/exposed secrets/production safety; no key ever committed; .gitignore + .env.example hygiene; strong reasoning model — high risk.

skill-boss.name: Skill Boss
skill-boss.responsibilities: Maintain the global skill registry; attach default skills to agents permanently; project-type bundles auto-attach; report missing skills + safe fallback; validate skill bundle + model match the agent's real task.

search-boss.name: Search Boss
search-boss.responsibilities: Approved search/research tools for current info; facts + sources + references; no hallucination; competitor/design/SEO/market research on request; source-grounded model.

build-boss.name: Build Boss
build-boss.responsibilities: Implement the actual code changes; follow architecture; clean, maintainable, tested code; never bypass QA/tests; coding-capable model only.

integration-boss.name: Integration Boss
integration-boss.responsibilities: NVIDIA Build/NIM, n8n, webhooks, Gmail, calendars, databases, payments; retries, timeouts, clear errors, fallbacks; clean documented config.

docs-boss.name: Docs Boss
docs-boss.responsibilities: Docs, setup instructions, architecture notes, env-var guides, final reports; simple language; exact commands; cheap/fast model unless complex architecture/security content.

specialistAgents._doc: 2026-09-26 (laptop re-audit D column: '7 specialist agents unregistered' — registry/model map listed 12 of 19 real .claude/agents/*.md files). OPTIONAL, domain-specific specialist agents — real agent-md files, dispatched directly by Boss/Head Chef when a work package needs this exact domain (Electron, payments, MCP, ML, data science) or on explicit request (codex-reviewer, verify-boss are opt-in second opinions/re-executors). Deliberately kept OUT of the `agents` map above: that map's exact count of 12 is a hard invariant several tools anchor on (e.g. nvidia-provider.test.cjs's 'agent registry has the 12 permanent Bosses'), and forge-certify.cjs's loadProjectAgentNames() already treats these as real on-request specialists proven by their own agent-md file, not by a registry row. Each entry here follows the SAME contract as a permanent Boss (permanent name + clear role + model assignment + self-review duty), added HERE template-first, then synced.

data-scientist.name: Data Scientist
data-scientist.responsibilities: Exploratory data analysis to statistical modeling with rigorous validation; always attaches honest uncertainty/confidence labels; never fabricates a metric or claims certainty. Dispatched for prediction/data-analysis work packages.

electron-pro.name: Electron Pro
electron-pro.responsibilities: Builds/hardens Electron apps: safe IPC, context isolation, no nodeIntegration in the renderer, and a real signed installer. Dispatched for desktop-app work packages.

mcp-developer.name: MCP Developer
mcp-developer.responsibilities: Builds/debugs MCP servers and clients: JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance, schema-validated inputs, minimal scopes, secure config. Dispatched for skill/integration authoring that exposes an MCP surface.

ml-engineer.name: ML Engineer
ml-engineer.responsibilities: Training-to-serving pipelines: reproducibility, model versioning, drift monitoring, safe rollout. Never triggers a real-money or irreversible action automatically. Dispatched for ML-pipeline work packages.

payment-integration.name: Payment Integration
payment-integration.responsibilities: Stripe/gateway integration, PCI-safe tokenization, verified webhooks, idempotent charge/refund flows. Never hardcodes a key. Dispatched for payment-integration work packages.

codex-reviewer.name: Codex Reviewer
codex-reviewer.responsibilities: On request only, never a mandatory gate: runs the official Codex plugin on the model pinned in config/orchestration/codex-review.json for an independent second opinion on important/sensitive code; falls back to a clearly labeled non-independent ECC review when Codex is unavailable.

verify-boss.name: Verify Boss
verify-boss.responsibilities: On request only, never a mandatory gate: re-runs the exact build/test/health-check command a Boss claims passed, from a cold read of the diff, and reports the literal exit code. Read+execute-only — can re-run a claim but can never edit the evidence it verifies.

extensionRule: New agent? Only with permanent name + role + skill bundle + model mapping + self-review + loop position, added to this file (template) and synced. Never spawn ad-hoc differently-named agents for work an existing Boss covers. Optional domain specialists and opt-in reviewers follow the same contract under `specialistAgents` above instead of the fixed 12-Boss `agents` map (which several tools anchor an exact count on).
_agentFilesNote: Each Boss/specialist has a real agent-definition file (agentFile) with frontmatter (name/description/tools/model, + memory:project ONLY for agents whose tool-policy class allows Write/Edit — dropped 2026-09-26 from review-boss/security-boss/search-boss/seo-boss/verify-boss because Claude Code turns memory:project into an automatic Write/Edit grant, which contradicted their read-only/exec-reviewer class) + body; the Lead dispatches Agent({subagent_type:<kebab>, model:<claudeTier>}). Files are template-owned + synced.
